line: Crowley's Queen of Wands: Hé of the Name (pdf p139); the watery part of Fire and the span from Pisces to Aries (pdf p143).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Queens (pdf p139) and on the Queen of Wands (pdf p143).

quotes.quote: The Queens represent the letter Hé of the Name.
The Queen of Wands represents the watery part of Fire, its fluidity and colour.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Pisces to the 20th degree of Aries (pdf p143); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: she rules in the Zodiac from the 21st degree of Pisces to the 20th degree of Aries
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Queen of Wands (pdf p143).

quotes.quote: The characteristics of the Queen are adaptability, persistent energy, calm authority which she knows how to use to enhance her attractiveness.
